attribution.explanation: Our LMP exceeds Cambium's marginal cost. Note: Cambium reports short-run marginal cost (SRMC), not all-in wholesale price. Our LMP includes capacity market revenues, scarcity pricing, and congestion — SRMC is a floor, not the full price.
